# Carousel design

**Swipe carousels for Instagram, TikTok photo mode and LinkedIn PDFs: hook slide, sizes, generated art, layout and export.**

Designs swipe carousels for Instagram, TikTok photo mode and LinkedIn document (PDF) posts — spine and slide count, a hook slide that earns the swipe, per-platform sizes and limits, slide art generated with @useclaudia/media, text layout with brand type and safe zones, PNG/JPEG/PDF export, alt text, AI labels and approval-first publishing. Use when someone wants a carousel, slide post, swipe post, photo-mode post or LinkedIn PDF carousel, or needs to turn a thread, tutorial or list into slides for an AI character or brand.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 60–90 min per carousel | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick the platform and canvas
2. Write the spine before any art
3. Make the hook slide earn the swipe
4. Generate the slide art
5. Lay out the text
6. Render and export
7. Write the caption, alt text and labels
8. Publish with approval
9. Review the swipe after 48 hours

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/carousel-design.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/carousel-design.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/carousel-design.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/carousel-design.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill carousel-design`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `carousel-design.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/carousel-design`.
